title: Counting q-Matroids
summary: $q$-Matroids, a $q$-analogue of classical matroids have attracted a lot of attention over the last decade, yet their enumeration remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we study the number of $q$-matroids, paving and sparse-paving $q$-matroids defined on a fixed ground space and with prescribed rank. We derive new lower bounds using constructions from constant-dimension codes and improve existing estimates.
